full_page.content:
Blessed be God in all His Designs! Jan. 13 - 1955
God bless you My Dear Sister Margaret - with Brother Frank and all your dear ones,
I just came across the herewith inclosed and tho't it might interest you. I presume my silence sometimes seems as tho' I had forgotten my friends. ... Ah! God help us! As years and decads pass I seem to get no - where with my correspon- dence.
Thank God, however, with hardly a positive exception my old friends seem earnest about saving their souls - which so unfortunally many seem to be indifferenct about ...... Our dear brothers, Fr. E'dand O.B.J. came to our jubilee - 2 Silver one golden - Every one present seemed more than pleased. Glory be! Poor dear Owen was not well but kept up good spirits .....
Fr. Solanus.
